Package neqsim.process.engineering.model

Class EngineeringDiagramDocumentSet

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.model.EngineeringDiagramDocumentSet
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class EngineeringDiagramDocumentSet extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable controlled-document view of one canonical EngineeringGraph.

The document set owns drawing and sheet identity, revision/status metadata, and paired off-page references without changing the semantic plant graph. It is an engineering proposal unless accountable approval evidence is supplied explicitly.

  • Method Details

    • fromGraph

      public static EngineeringDiagramDocumentSet fromGraph(EngineeringGraph graph, String drawingNumber, String title, EngineeringDiagramDocumentSet.ContentProfile profile, List<EngineeringDiagramDocumentSet.Diagnostic> inheritedDiagnostics)
      Creates a deterministic area-sheet view of a canonical graph.

      A single-area graph produces one sheet. A multi-area graph produces one sheet per area and projects each cross-area connection through reciprocal off-page connectors while preserving one semantic connection identity.

      Parameters:
      graph - canonical semantic graph
      drawingNumber - controlled drawing number
      title - document-set title
      profile - requested content profile
      inheritedDiagnostics - diagnostics produced by the source adapter
      Returns:
      immutable controlled-document proposal
